Administration

Asset Groups

📅 Published June 2025 📂 Platform: Keytelemetrics 👤 Audience: Administrators

Asset Groups control and manage assets of the same type or group. Assets can be assigned to multiple groups simultaneously. Unlike Cost Centres, there are no access restrictions — any user can see any group's assets.

Applies to: Assets  ·  Alerts  ·  Reports

1. Understanding the Structure

Asset Groups use a parent-child relationship. Unlike Cost Centres, there can be multiple parent Asset Groups. The highest level is called Root. By default, one parent group called Default exists — rename it and build children beneath it.

Tip: Plan your Asset Group structure before creating it — consider grouping by vehicle type, depot, region, or fleet category.

2. Creating Asset Groups

Step 1 — Navigate to Asset Groups

Go to Administration → Organisation → Asset Groups. Select the Default Group and click Edit next to Asset Group Details:

Step 2 — Rename the Default Group

Because multiple parent groups are allowed, the highest level is called Root. Rename the Default group and keep the Parent set to Root:

After saving, the renamed group appears with Root as parent:

Step 3 — Add Child Groups

Click the + button to open the Asset Group Wizard. Create new groups under the Root or the renamed parent:

Keep adding groups until your structure is complete. Example of a finished structure:

3. Editing Asset Group Information

Edit any group to change its Name or Parent, and to add Contacts. Contacts appear on the Overview and Alerts screens with clickable email and phone links.

Adding a Contact

Click Edit next to Contacts, then Add to open the Contact Details form:

Once saved, the contact displays in the Contacts panel:

The contact information then appears with clickable links on the asset's Overview screen and in Alerts:

4. Viewing Assets in a Group

Select any Asset Group from the list, then open the Assets section to see all assets assigned to that group:
